scope: Numerical reproduction and source provenance; not engineering validation

gaugeFactor.status: Workbook calculation factor; no sensor calibration certificate supplied

methodsChosen.detail: Final initial zero-load Raw Data row19 chosen for all21 channels; processed workbook uses a different baseline.
3.304*(f_zero^2-f_current^2)/1000; reverse sign of the workbook processed delta formula.
Workbook3.304 convention applied to all21 channels SG1-SG7; individual calibration remains unverified.
Equal arithmetic mean of all3 gauges per level, no sensor exclusion or imputation; stage time mean is unweighted arithmetic mean of the recorded means.

UniformE=34GPa times strain; gross circular area pi*1.2^2/4; ignore reinforcement contribution, steel area, composite stiffness, and modulus variation. Derived stress and axial force are increments relative to the chosen baseline, not absolute stress or force; initial stress, self-weight, and buoyancy corrections were not supplied/applied.
1tf=9806.65N; exact conventional SI conversion rather than workbook rounded10.1972tf/cm2 perGPa.
Contiguous equal recorded load groups, checked against source markers; baseline0, stages1-15 loading,16-18 unloading. Recorded load retained unchanged; no halving/doubling.

Upper deeper force minus shallower; lower shallower minus deeper; divide bypi*diameter*intervalLength for mean shaft stress. Negative results preserved. These interval estimates are baseline-relative shaft-stress increments; they do not include an independently known initial resistance distribution.
Spread computed ifabs(mean)>=20microstrain; flagspread>25%. Interval flagged ifeitherendpointflagged ortransfernegative. These are report review heuristics, not acceptance criteria.
No gauge extrapolation to pilehead/cellboundaries; no measured head point inserted; no force line across O-cell; no synthesized local displacement/capacity.

derivedQuantityInterpretation.strain: Compression strain change relative to the final zero-load baseline at Raw Data row19.
derivedQuantityInterpretation.stress: Baseline-relative estimated concrete stress increment E times delta-strain, not absolute concrete stress.
derivedQuantityInterpretation.force: Baseline-relative estimated axial-force increment E times gross area times delta-strain, not absolute in-situ axial force.
derivedQuantityInterpretation.shaftFriction: Baseline-relative estimated mean shaft-stress increment from differences of adjacent incremental force estimates, not an absolute soil-resistance profile.
